title: cnpg-cluster
description: A CNPG Cluster whose posture is chosen by a platform-injected profile. See docs/reference.md for the full value-by-value reference.

global.description: Helm injects `global` into every subchart's values, so a strict schema must admit it or the chart cannot be embedded as a dependency. The chart reads nothing from it.

clusterName.description: Name of the CNPG Cluster and the prefix for every resource this chart renders.

namespace.description: Namespace the Cluster and its companion resources are rendered into.

profile.description: Platform-injected posture: 'devel' (1 instance, no PDB) or 'prod' (3 instances, PDB, quorum failover, WAL volume). Required — an empty/unset value fails the render rather than silently choosing a posture.

annotations.description: Annotations stamped on the Cluster CR and on the ObjectStore.

labels.description: Labels stamped on the Cluster CR and, via inheritedMetadata, fanned out to its Pods/PVCs/Services by the operator's INHERITED_LABELS setting.

enabled.description: Turns on continuous WAL archiving and renders the backup ObjectStore. Empty bucketName keeps archiving off even when true.

expected.description: Whether this cluster is meant to be backed up. false opts out of the platform's 'backup not configured' alert and requires notExpectedReason.

notExpectedReason.description: Why the cluster is deliberately not backed up. Required, non-empty, when expected is false.

bucketName.description: S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket backups are written to. Empty = archiving off.

s3Prefix.description: Prefix under the bucket. Defaults to '{namespace}/{clusterName}/' when empty.

serverName.description: Barman server directory under the prefix. Defaults to clusterName. Bump on a recreated (fresh initdb) cluster so it does not reuse its predecessor's archive directory.

schedule.description: Cron schedule for the ScheduledBackup, e.g. '0 0 2 * * *'.

immediate.description: Take the first base backup as soon as the ScheduledBackup is created rather than at the first cron tick. Ignored by the operator on a ScheduledBackup that has already run.

retentionDays.description: Functional PITR window, enforced by the barman-cloud plugin's pruning.

walCompression.description: WAL segment compression algorithm passed to the barman-cloud plugin.

dataCompression.description: Base backup compression algorithm passed to the barman-cloud plugin (a narrower enum than WAL's).

encryption.description: Server-side encryption header requested on every upload (e.g. AES256). Empty sends no x-amz-server-side-encryption header, which is required by stores that reject it (Cloudflare R2 among them).

endpoint.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL (Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Ceph RGW, ...). Empty keeps the AWS endpoint.

key.description: Key inside the Secret holding the PEM bundle.

endpointCA.description: Secret holding the PEM bundle that verifies a private endpoint's certificate. Both keys are required together.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret with static AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Empty keeps the pod's ambient identity (inheritFromIAMRole).

existingSecretKeys.description: Key names read from existingSecret. sessionToken and region are only referenced when named.

backup.description: Backup coordinates: the bucket and identity that may write to it are the platform's to mint and hand in here.

mode.description: 'initdb' creates a fresh database; 'recovery' bootstraps from bootstrap.recovery.source.

database.description: Bootstrap database name. Empty renders no initdb bootstrap block.

owner.description: Technical owner role for the bootstrap database (used by migration jobs, not interactively). Also the implicit owner for entries in databases[]/customers[] that don't set their own.

schemas.description: Declarative schemas on the bootstrap database.

source.description: The archive to recover from; may be a different store than the one this cluster archives to going forward.

targetTime.description: PITR target timestamp. Empty recovers to the latest available point.

bootstrap.description: How the cluster's first database comes to exist: a fresh initdb, or recovery from an archive.

databases.description: Additional databases in this cluster (absorbs the retired cnpg-database chart).

customers.description: Shared-cluster, database-per-customer shape: each entry renders a Database owned by the bootstrap owner plus a '{name}-access' NOLOGIN role.

auth.description: cert = operator-issued mTLS client certificate; password = the compatibility path, which requires passwordSecret.

passwordSecret.description: Existing kubernetes.io/basic-auth Secret. Required when auth=password on a non-owner role; the chart never generates passwords.

roles.description: Application/technical roles rendered as DatabaseRole CRs.

instances.description: Instance count. Null = profile default (devel 1, prod 3). prod requires >= 3.

storageClass.description: Empty = profile default (devel cnpg-gp3-delete, prod cnpg-gp3).

size.description: WAL volume size. prod only; devel skips the WAL volume entirely.

resources.description: Raw Kubernetes ResourceRequirements. Empty = profile default (devel 100m/256Mi req + 512Mi limit; prod 250m/512Mi req + 1Gi limit). A set value replaces the default wholesale.

parameters.description: Extra postgresql.conf parameters, merged over the profile's own (synchronous_commit, shared_buffers, max_slot_wal_keep_size).

extra_pg_hba.description: Extra pg_hba.conf lines, appended AFTER the catch-all cert line, where first-match hba never reaches them. Kept for compatibility; use pgHba.beforeCatchAll.

beforeCatchAll.description: Extra pg_hba.conf lines placed before the catch-all cert line.

name.description: Empty name = the operator's own CA (default).

privateKey.description: Passed through to the Certificate's spec.privateKey, e.g. {algorithm: ECDSA, size: 384}.

caCertificates.description: PEM roots that verify the issued chain. Required when issuerRef.name is set.

existingSecret.description: Names-only mode: an existing kubernetes.io/tls Secret for the server certificate. Set together with existingCASecret, not with issuerRef. Its producer must label it cnpg.io/reload.

existingCASecret.description: Names-only mode: an existing Secret holding the server CA in ca.crt. Set together with existingSecret, not with issuerRef. Its producer must label it cnpg.io/reload.

serverTLS.description: Optional: take the SERVER certificate from a cert-manager issuer instead of the operator's own self-signed CA. Client CA, replication and pg_hba are unaffected.

namespace.description: cert-manager's cluster resource namespace, also trust-manager's trust namespace. Required with ca or bundle.

roles.description: Common names the policy admits, besides streaming_replica.

extraCertificates.description: Extra PEM roots added to the client CA bundle.

trust.description: Optional per-database client trust, installed by the platform once per cluster.

secretName.description: Secret written by the replication Certificate and named by spec.certificates.replicationTLSSecret. Empty = <clusterName>-replication-tls.

role.description: The database role the person may connect as. pg_ prefixes are refused.

people.description: Humans authenticating with a client certificate whose CN is the email; rows of the people pg_ident map.

enabled.description: Render a monitoring.coreos.com/v1 PodMonitor for the instance pods (port metrics, /metrics) when the cluster serves that API. Default true.

interval.description: Scrape interval, e.g. 30s. Empty = the scraper's default.

dropPgSettings.description: Drop the cnpg_pg_settings_* metric family (roughly 500-700 series per instance). Default true.

keepPgSettings.description: Settings (the name label of cnpg_pg_settings_setting) kept when dropPgSettings is on. Empty = drop the whole family.

metricRelabelings.description: Passed through to the endpoint after the pg_settings drop; write action explicitly on every rule.

labels.description: Extra labels on the PodMonitor object.

enabled.description: Optional. Unset = render exactly when from is non-empty. true with an empty from fails the render; false suppresses the object.

from.description: NetworkPolicyPeer entries allowed to reach the metrics port (TCP 9187). Empty = no NetworkPolicy.

monitoring.description: Metrics scraping of the instance pods.

databasePool.description: Karpenter (or any) node pool name. Selects nodeSelector 'karpenter.sh/nodepool' and adds a matching Equal/NoSchedule toleration automatically. Empty/absent = no pool, no nodeSelector, no pool toleration.

tolerations.description: Extra raw Kubernetes tolerations (passthrough — left open, like resources above), appended after the pool's own (if any). Empty/absent = none.

scheduling.description: Node placement. Both keys are estate facts (a pool name, a taint) and have no default — set them to reproduce a specific platform's shape.
